name: Flexible Dual Grid Mesh Voxelization
definition: Determines the active sparse voxels and solves the Quadratic Error Function (QEF) to determine dual vertex positions within voxels based on mesh-voxel grid intersections.
summary: Flexible Dual Grid Mesh Voxelization identifies active sparse voxels intersected by a triangle mesh and solves an enhanced Quadratic Error Function to compute dual vertex positions, differing from O-Voxel by providing raw voxel indices and intersection flags without higher-level serialization.
